Fixes the Floatplane creator list in the settings popup, which was blank in 0.5.0.

### Fixed
- The Floatplane section of the settings popup lists creators again. It shows Detour's own creator list by default, so no Floatplane login is needed.

Everything else is as in [0.5.0](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.5.0), including the new store name, Nebula podcast links and the larger matched-video list.

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), or load the zip below.
